samples.title: reaper 2d interactions
samples.description: 250 strokes (110 inside, 140 outside) on 29 of the 36 views, drawn between iterations 0 and 912. Recorded with the photos as input, Chan-Vese energy, the CFL update (force percentile 25), smoothing 0.386 and re-init every 5 / step 0.5, at grid 300. The camera and starting box were not saved with it, so the dataset's own settings apply. Plug in adds it to the current run; Play re-initialises with those settings and replays it.
